displayIdentity.body: Tychicus and Onesimus carry news. All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord. together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
